mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4, increasing isocarboxazid metabolite levels and MAOI effects; combined CNS depression and potential serotonergic potentiation.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use alternative H2-blocker (famotidine); if unavoidable, reduce isocarboxazid dose and monitor for hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and excessive CNS depression.
